L59: ### Ethos Precision Medicine Umbrella Study for Hemangiosarcoma (ePUSH)
L60: 
L61: Open
L62: 
L63: Ethos-PUSH looks to assess the efficacy of new treatment options for dogs with hemangiosarcoma (HSA).
L64: 
L65: ## How Ethos-PUSH Study Presents New Treatment Options for Blood Cancer in Dogs
L66: #### Description
L67: The Ethos-PUSH study seeks to deliver a highly advanced program investigating the use of novel drugs for the treatment of hemangiosarcoma (HSA) with the goal of curing this aggressive cancer.  【24†Ethos Discovery†ethosdiscov.wpenginepowered.com】’s previous work in HSA has taught us that HSA is not a single cancer but is rather at least four different subtypes of cancer, each characterized by a different genomic mutation.
L68:  Previous studies evaluating drugs for the treatment of HSA have shown variable results, and the discovery of these different subtypes could explain this phenomenon.
L69: This study will ask if drugs specifically matched to these genomic subtypes of patients with HSA can improve their outcomes. Our trial has already demonstrated that a greater number of dogs (40-50%) with a ruptured splenic tumor end up having a benign diagnosis that is cured with surgery alone.
L70: #### Eligibility criteria
L71: 
L72:   * Any dog diagnosed with a ruptured splenic tumor whose owners are pursuing surgery for splenectomy.
L73:   * No evidence of metastasis as determined via chest x-rays and during surgery.
L74: 
L75:   * Dogs weighing more than 5kg and  less than 45kg
L76: 
L77: What We’ve Learned:
L78:   * We have learned that many splenic tumors are benign (40-50%) and can be cured with surgery alone.
L79:   * Enrolling participants in this trial offers owners and their pets more hope.
L80:   * Future dogs and humans will benefit from the results of this research.
L81: #### What to Expect
L82: 
L83: Eligible patients will have various blood, tissue, and fecal samples collected at the time of splenectomy surgery. Patients found to have HSA following surgery will be eligible to continue on to the second phase of the trial and will receive cutting-edge therapies at no cost to the pet owner.
L84: 
L85:   * Procedures typically begin 1 week after the splenectomy surgery.
L86:   * This study consists of around 10 study visits over 1 year.
L87: #### Pet Owner Resources
L88: 
L89: Click the links below for more information about eligibility, steps, timelines, and treatments associated with this study.
L90: 
L91:   * 【25†Study Guide: Hemoabdomen†ethosdiscov.wpenginepowered.com】 – ETHOS-PUSH Phase 1
L92:   * 【26†Study Guide: Hemangiosarcoma †ethosdiscov.wpenginepowered.com】 – ETHOS-PUSH Phase 2
L93: Participation in a clinical study is subject to medical eligibility and availability requirements. Financial incentives, including potential stipends or reimbursements, are contingent upon meeting study criteria and completing required visits or activities. Additional terms and conditions may apply.
L94: ### Interested?
L95: 
L96: Enroll or request more information below
L97: 
L98: ##### Benefits of Participation
L99: ###### Participating pet owners will receive:
L100: 
L101:   * $1,000 towards the cost of surgery.
L102:   * The cost of treating side effects associated with either study will also be covered up to a total of $3,000.
L103:   * Dogs confirmed to have hemangiosarcoma with no evidence of metastasis will be eligible to continue to the fully funded treatment phase of the study at no cost to the client (> $10,000 value).

L59: ### Dysbiosis Enhancing Linkage Towards Association with Canine Hemangiosarcoma (DEL-HSA)
L60: 
L61: Open
L62: 
L63: #### Description
L64: 
L65: Hemangiosarcoma (HSA) is an aggressive cancer in dogs and carries a poor prognosis. There are limited therapeutic options for the treatment of HSA, with none currently providing a significant opportunity for long-term survival.
L66: 
L67: The Intestinal Dysbiosis Program is investigating the associations between the presence of dysbiosis and the development and metastasis of HSA.
L68: #### Eligibility Criteria
L69: 
L70:   * Dogs being concurrently enrolled in the 【24†Ethos-PUSH trial.†ethosdiscov.wpenginepowered.com】
